source_review.notes: Checked OpenAPI Specification 3.1.1, AsyncAPI Specification 3.0.0, JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 Core, CloudEvents 1.0.2, W3C DCAT 3, W3C PROV-O, Google's SRE chapter on Service Level Objectives, and NIST Privacy Framework 1.0. All eight official or primary destinations returned HTTP 200. Claims remain bounded to machine-readable interfaces, validation, common event context, catalog relationships, provenance, service-objective practice, or privacy-risk framing; none of these sources is presented as a complete producer-consumer contract by itself.
